utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by late and help for a bit, and I’ll wait for Hana to check the sign-up sheet first so I know what tools and supplies are still needed. I’ll also help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep track of what supplies we’re still short on. Vik’s helping spread the word and keep everyone updated, and Bo, Sam, and Uli are helping too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll catch up late and help however I can once Hana checks the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Quinn’s been making sure everyone knows where to head for the repair drive. Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers, so you’re set once you get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I’ll be there for the repair drive. Good to know Quinn put me on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — just head to the repair drive spot when you can. Mara and Dane are helping spread the word too, so you should find folks there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, an hour or two on Saturday would help. Do you want to take tools, spare parts, or donation sorting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m hearing Gus is bringing the main tools, and Bo’s got some hand tools and gloves too. I can help with sorting the donations if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sorting donations would be really useful—thanks, Nell. If you can spare an hour or two on Saturday, I’ll count on you for that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send you the updated repair drive details as soon as I have them, including the drop-off window. Bo’s bringing a few hand tools and gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off window and pass along anything you send. I’ll help once I’ve got the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send the updated details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday works — I’ll pass along any repair drive news I hear. Cleo said Rosa has it organized, so I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, thanks—I’ll keep folks posted too. Mara’s spreading the word, and she’s checking what tools she can bring for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that’ll help a lot. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new about Saturday’s repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m helping out and I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll set aside a hammer and a few screwdrivers for Noah. We should be in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, sounds like we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Rey — I’ll sort the donations and help load a few boxes when the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got my work gloves and hammer ready for the repair drive here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’m a little forgetful, but I’ll stick to sorting the donations and loading boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive too, and I’ll see what tools I can bring. Faye, your help around school drop-off and pickup times would be really useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help around drop-off or pickup, whichever helps most. Keep me posted on the repair drive schedule, and I’ll fit in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep you posted on the schedule. Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers, and I’ll check what else I can add.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good—if we’re still missing a hammer and a few screwdrivers, I’d rather sort that out sooner before it gets busy later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great idea—I’ve got Rey bringing a hammer, and I’ll log whatever comes in this afternoon. If we’re still short on screwdrivers, we can flag that right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out so we can catch any missing screwdrivers before it gets hectic.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll spread the word to both friend groups and make sure they get the details. Mara said she’ll see what tools she can bring, so that should help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. I’m bringing a wrench set and spare screwdrivers, and I’ll check the west side of the repair tent for loose boxes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Sam — I’ll keep both groups updated so everyone knows what to bring. I’ll also make sure Opal gets the details, and we can compare notes once the tent’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got the list ready: Sam’s bringing a wrench set and spare screwdrivers, Rey’s bringing work gloves and a hammer, and Gus can bring whatever tools he already has. I’ll send it over to Gus now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—Sam is bringing the wrench set and screwdrivers, right? And Bo is helping too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s right—Sam’s bringing the wrench set and spare screwdrivers. I don’t have Bo on the list yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I’ll make sure Bo’s in the loop, and I’ll ask Mara to keep spreading the word and see what tools she can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — before we do that, let’s check the sign-up sheet first so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good call — let’s check the sign-up sheet first, then I’ll follow up with Bo and Mara.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d check the sign-up sheet first so we have the details right. Then we can make sure both groups get the repair drive info.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good idea — I’ll check the sign-up sheet and make sure both groups get the repair drive details. I’m also still bringing the wrench set and spare screwdrivers on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — that sounds right. Once you check the sheet, we’ll have the details straight and can keep both groups in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts. Who can take one?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take a Saturday shift if you can match it to drop-off or pickup time. Mara, please keep me posted on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works — I’ll match your shift to drop-off or pickup and let you know. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there for the repair drive. Thanks for putting me on Quinn’s invite list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — I’ll keep an ear out for Leo’s update and the drop-off window, then pass it along when I get it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate it — just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oren, thanks for sorting the donations and loading those boxes when Vik’s ready. Uli, Bo, and Sam are helping with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. Bo’s got the tools and gloves, and Hana can help keep everyone updated on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — then we’re set on supplies and updates. I’ll keep an eye on what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — Bo and Sam are helping, and Bo’s already on the invite list. Mara’s going to help spread the word too, so I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll make sure Opal gets the details too so both friend groups stay in the loop. And it’s great that Mara and Bo are already helping out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect — the more folks in the loop, the better. I’ll keep passing it along so the repair drive stays busy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m keeping an ear out for any fresh updates on the repair drive, and I’ll pass them along to Pia as soon as I hear something. Mara’s checking what tools she can bring, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by late on Sunday at the community center and help for a bit. Once Hana checks the sign-up sheet, I’ll see what tools and supplies are still needed and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Dane — late Sunday at the community center should help a lot. I’ll keep listening for any new updates and let Pia know as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — please let me know the drop-off window as soon as you hear it. If it’s going to get busy later, sooner sounds easier.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the drop-off window as soon as I hear it. If it looks busy later, I’ll flag that too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’d appreciate that. Once you know the window, I can plan around it and avoid the rush.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers, and Dane and Mara are helping spread the word. Jules is sharing the details with both friend groups and encouraging everyone to come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great — I’ve got my work gloves and a hammer ready too. I’ll let Ira know to pass along anything they hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — with your gloves and hammer, we’re set. If Ira hears anything else, send it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like Gus is bringing the tools on Saturday, and Bo’s got the hand tools and gloves covered. I’ll let Noah know to expect that hammer and those screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the plan around town. Ira’s listening for updates, Cleo’s tracking what’s still needed, and Oren’s ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, that should keep everyone in the loop. I’ll pass it along if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll be here this afternoon to log Cleo’s screws and tape, and I’ve noted Rey’s gloves and hammer too. The repair drive is still set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send Gus the list this afternoon so he knows what to bring. We’re still on for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks — that’ll help keep everything organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—Rosa’s got the repair drive organized, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Rosa’s handling the screws and tape, right? And Sam’s bringing tools too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that sounds right—I’ll keep an eye out for any new details on the screws, tape, and tools while I’m out. If I hear anything about the Saturday repair drive, I’ll let you know.
